The podium of the most commented videos in Europe this week.

Data from the official YouTube API. Synthetic voice narration. #Top10RS #shorts

escenas.texto: Which was the most commented video in Europe this week? Here is the podium. Watch until the end.
In third place, GTA 6 Feels Like Something's Off..., by IAmBeanz, with over 9 thousand comments.
In second place, La fin du duo. (Ninjaxx & Nino), by Ninjaxx, with over 13 thousand comments.
And number one: Maç Kaybedersem Takipçilerime Gta6 Hediye Ediyorum, by HYPNOS CR, with over 16 thousand comments.
The full countdown, from ten to one, is already on the channel. Find it in the description. Hashtag Top 10 RS.
